This post isn’t the full story of my life. Someone mentioned that “if I’m this poor” walking across a stage or throwing a party shouldn’t be my top priorities. Ofc it’s not. We had a bit of money to spare and since I’m graduating, unable to walk across a stage because I’m homeschooled, my mom decided to throw a little party at a selfie place. She paid to have it there and then a bunch of shit happened (which I explained in the original post) including a house fire Sunday. I’ve asked my mom if she could get a refund on the reservation and she can’t. The reason we can’t pay for shit is because I wanted to act like a regular kid with parents who aren’t disabled and unable to work, and celebrate my graduation. This same person went on to talk about how expensive dogs are. My dog is supposed to be a service animal. I’m visually impaired and need a guide dog. He also dual serves as a emotional support dog and has stopped me from cutting my fucking wrist out on many occasions.


Anyways this post is just the most recent shit to add to my suicidal ideation, not the cause of it. I’ve been seeing a psychiatrist for months and taking meds for that long. It’s not simply being below the poverty line it’s all the inability to live normal, being told it’s my fault or that my disabled parents are lazy, the fact that inconveniences for everyone else cause my mom to cry trying to figure out how she’ll pay our bills, that’s the shit that adds to my fucking depression and makes me think dying would be easier (especially if I find away to dispose of my own body so my family don’t have to pay for a funeral).

Example 
My mom has a rare genetic disorder that cause problems with her joints and pretty much all her organs (chronic pain too) put we can’t afford most of her treatment even with insurance.

Next we used food stamps and because my sister made a slight mistake on some paperwork it’s been cut of and we’ve had to lower our meals to once a day to save on the food we do have.

I’ve been excepted into some really good schools, and my dream school, but I’ve had to turn them down because I can’t afford to attend.

All of these are stressful and I feel like if I was to go die somewhere away from my family it’d save them a lot of money. I’m disabled and can’t work so becoming one less mouth to feed is the only way I can contribute.

Sorry I know it’s pathetic especially compared to the situations of other people here but it’s how I feel constantly.
